pearl_fishery_2 = {

	construction_time = construction_time_9_months
	district_level_requirement = {
        value = 2
        if = { limit = { has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active } value = 0 }
    }
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
		county = { pearl_fishing_banks_county_trigger = yes }
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_2_cost
	province_modifier = {
		trade_good_gems_production_add = pearl_fishery_gems_tier_2
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_maritime_tax = pearl_fishery_income_tier_2
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_maritime_tax = pearl_fishery_income_tier_2_tribal
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	next_building = pearl_fishery_3
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_need_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_gems }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_income_production_building_modifier = yes
		ai_market_shortage_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_gems }
		ai_resource_building_upgrade_modifier = { LEVEL = 2 }
	}

}
